questions.question: Create a series of experimental studies exploring product design and development. Annotate your process.

points.text: A range of experimental studies showing different approaches to product design and development, each annotated with media, technique and purpose. Show development from initial experiments to refined outcomes.

questions.question: Research an artist or designer who works with product design and development. Write a critical analysis of their approach and explain how it has informed your own work.

points.text: A critical analysis naming a specific artist/designer, using specialist vocabulary, explaining their context and approach, and making clear connections to personal work.

questions.question: Evaluate the effectiveness of your experiments with product design and development. Which approaches were most successful and why?

points.text: A reflective evaluation identifying successful and less successful experiments, explaining WHY using technical and conceptual language, and showing how evaluation led to further refinement.

questions.question: Full-Mark Response Design a product addressing a specific user need. Show your complete process from brief through research, ideation, prototyping and final design. Annotate your decisions about ergonomics, materials and sustainability. <div class="

points.text: A grade 9 response will: demonstrate thorough user research; generate multiple ideas; develop a functional prototype; justify material and manufacturing choices; annotate with specialist vocabulary (ergonomics, anthropometrics, lifecycle); consider sustainability throughout. Mark scheme: AO1 (develop through investigation) + AO2 (refine through experimentation) + AO3 (record ideas and observations) + AO4 (present personal response) = total marks
